checks.evidence: Frozen release includes the model, llama-server, and bundled dylibs; the candidate executable loaded from its own package. No separately installed llama-server was used.

Normal launch used the packaged offline model/runtime; manifest says network_downloads=false, model SHA stayed fixed, launcher has no model fetch path, and the live llama-server had no external socket.
Candidate freeze, release metadata, runtime manifest, and model manifest hashes match. Tampering was rejected and the exact runtime SHA was restored.
Packaged start automatically launched the embedded runtime and reported ready; lsof captured the candidate PID listening on 127.0.0.1:8767.
Runtime manifest has Metal enabled; lsof captured the candidate's packaged libggml-metal.0.dylib and the exact Qwen GGUF loaded by the live process.
Packaged start's Docker-core host.docker.internal probe passed; the core returned embedded_local ready.
Playwright on the frozen candidate rendered Local embedded AI ready; screenshot at eai14-647c267-ui.png.
Synthetic high_rtt completed in model_assisted mode, accepted tcp.rtt, and retained 17 evidence records linked to unchanged capture SHA; see eai14-647c267-case.json.

Candidate UI invoked both Full Capture and Evidence Capture in native Wireshark. Filter tcp.stream == 0; original and derived artifact hashes are recorded in eai14-647c267-native-artifacts.json and eai14-647c267-ui-actions.json.

Terminated only the candidate-owned PID after verifying executable identity; API stayed healthy, a new case used model_fallback/runtime-unhealthy, and deterministic tcp.rtt remained; see eai14-647c267-fallback.json.
Packaged stop/start recovered embedded AI; original model-assisted case, report, capture SHA, and 17 evidence records remained intact; see eai14-647c267-recovery.json.
Candidate release, isolated HOME, data root, and capture paths contained spaces; packaged stop/start preserved data and model assets.
Controlled 127.0.0.1:8767 conflict yielded port-in-use and healthy deterministic-only API; see eai14-647c267-port-conflict-health.json.
One-byte runtime tamper produced invalid-bundle and deterministic-only API; the byte was restored and SHA reverified before restart.
lsof showed app 127.0.0.1:28775, bridge 127.0.0.1:28776, and AI 127.0.0.1:8767 only; AI sockets had no external peer.
Current ephemeral AI key was absent from runtime log and isolated data root; full current-head privacy/injection tests passed.

limitations: No full-host packet capture was made for the no-download check; evidence combines packaged offline assets, fixed launcher path, network_downloads=false policy, unchanged model SHA, and no external llama-server socket.
